_meta.name: Product Launch Sprint Engine
_meta.description: Generates a launch plan (calendar, assets, UTM, stakeholder assignments) from a launch brief and persists results for tracking.

nodes.name: Fetch Launch Brief
nodes.description: Retrieve synthetic launch briefs for planning.

nodes.name: Plan Launch
nodes.description: Create campaign calendar, asset checklist, and UTM parameters.

nodes.name: Verify Plan & Policy
nodes.description: Validate launch plan completeness and enforce policy (e.g., budget caps).

nodes.name: Draft Launch Assets
nodes.description: Generate drafts for presentation, email, social posts, etc.

nodes.name: Route & Request Approval
nodes.description: Assign owners, create approval request for launch execution.

nodes.name: Persist Launch Attribution
nodes.description: Store launch plan metrics and asset metadata for dashboards.
